subject: MAP: Limited-use eval kits & takeback schedule
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Emma Wu <emma.wu@brightcart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: Limited-use eval kits & takeback schedule

Hi Emma —

Great talking earlier. Per our MAP discussion, attached is an initial draft that lays out the limited-use eval kit handoff, acceptance criteria, and the takedown timeline we discussed. Key points up front:

- Scope: 3 prompt packs + dataset sampling (~10k examples) for model evaluation and integration tests.
- Access window: proposed 14 days ephemeral access from delivery.
- Usage constraints: no re-distribution, no indexing outside BrightCart private project, no training of models for production.
- Acceptance: pass the acceptance testcases (attached) or provide written counter-examples within 48 hours of test completion.
- Takeback: Redwood to perform automatic wipe and provide retention/erasure certificate within 7 days of takedown.

Actions requested from your side: confirm the 14-day window or suggest an alternate, flag any additional compliance asks (audit logs, retention proofs), and confirm procurement contact for a quick MPA signature.

I've attached: redwood_map_draft_v1.pdf, sample-promptpack-v0.3.zip, acceptance-testcases.csv (stubs).

Proposed timeline (high-level):
- 11/24: Deliver eval kit to BrightCart sandbox
- 11/25–12/08: BrightCart evaluation window (14 days)
- 12/09: Final acceptance sign-off; Redwood takedown by 12/16 (7-day takedown window)

If that looks reasonable I'll have Ben and Monica coordinate the delivery and monitoring.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_map_draft_v1.pdf (13 pages), sample-promptpack-v0.3.zip (3 files), acceptance-testcases.csv (11 rows)
From: Emma Wu <emma.wu@brightcart.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightcart.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Limited-use eval kits & takeback schedule

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks for the write-up and the attachments. High level this looks good and aligns with what our ML org needs. A couple of asks from the compliance side:

1) Can we shorten the evaluation window to 10 days instead of 14? Our internal policy requires tighter ephemeral windows for third-party material.
2) We will need audit log access for actions performed during the window (S3 access logs + API call traces) — can Redwood provide read-only access to a consolidated audit log slice for the evaluation period?
3) Procurement loop added (procurement@brightcart.com) — they will send a standard MPA rider; can we aim to get the agreement signed this week?

If those three items are possible we'll proceed. I'll loop in the procurement contact shortly.

—Emma
Emma Wu
Head of ML
BrightCart Systems
emma.wu@brightcart.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Emma Wu <emma.wu@brightcart.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Limited-use eval kits & takeback schedule

Thanks Emma — we can accommodate the asks. A few operational details to lock down:

- Evaluation window: will set to 10 days (deliver on 11/30, takedown window begins 10 days after delivery).
- Audit logs: Redwood will provide a read-only consolidated audit bundle (S3 access logs + request traces) for the evaluation window. We'll redact low-level IPs but include timestamps, request IDs, and resource identifiers.
- Evidence: after takedown Redwood will generate a deletion certificate and a short audit summary (CSV).

Proposed updated timeline (final):
- 11/30 09:00 PST: Delivery of eval kit to BrightCart sandbox (deliverable: sample-promptpack-v0.3.zip, dataset-sample-10k.tar.gz stub)
- 11/30–12/09: BrightCart eval window (10 days)
- 12/10: Acceptance results due (BrightCart to confirm pass/fail against acceptance-testcases.csv)
- 12/11–12/18: Redwood takedown and final deletion certificate issued by 12/18

I'll prepare a short MPA rider that captures the shortened window and the audit log deliverable. Stephanie / Monica — I'll hand this to procurement once Emma confirms.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachment: revised-timeline-v2.xlsx (schedule stub)
From: Emma Wu <emma.wu@brightcart.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightcart.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 14:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Limited-use eval kits & takeback schedule

Ben / Stephanie —

Thanks for the quick turn. Confirming we accept the 10-day window and the audit-log bundle. Two small clarifications before procurement signs off:

- Retention: no BrightCart-side copies may be retained past 30 days from the takedown event; please include a clause requiring BrightCart to certify deletion by that date.
- Audit detail: procurement requests that the audit bundle contain SHA256 hashes of delivered files plus the delivery manifest so they can verify integrity during the window.

Once those clauses are in the rider we'll route to procurement. procurement@brightcart.com — if you need a fancier SOW or addendum we'll respond.

Emma / procurement —

Thanks — all good on Redwood's side. We'll update the rider to include:
- Evaluation window: 11/30–12/09 (10 days)
- BrightCart retention clause: no copies retained beyond 30 days from takedown; BrightCart to attest deletion in writing.
- Delivery manifest: Redwood will include SHA256 hashes and a delivery manifest in the audit bundle; audit bundle will be available read-only for the evaluation window.
- Deletion certificate: Redwood issues within 7 days of takedown, plus an audit summary CSV.

Next steps (today):
1) Ben will upload the rider to the DocuSign link and tag procurement contact.
2) Monica will coordinate sandbox access and deliver the prompt pack + dataset stub on 11/30 09:00 PST.
3) Emma / BrightCart to run acceptance testcases and provide final acceptance by 12/10.

I'll attach the revised rider and ping once the DocuSign envelope is live. Looking forward to closing this MAP and getting the eval rolling.

Best —
Stephanie Nguyen
